common.protocol.responsibility: LAN JSON event envelope, checksum validation, reliability metadata preservation, timestamp helpers.

common.events.responsibility: Canonical LAN WebSocket event names and constructors.

common.security.responsibility: Session-specific signing, replay protection, and optional encryption for sensitive LAN events.

common.ipc_ws.responsibility: Loopback-only token-authenticated WebSocket IPC and stdio transport selection helpers.

common.incident_rules.responsibility: Normalize, match, prioritize, summarize, and apply incident rule definitions.

server.main.responsibility: Server CLI parsing, validation, duplicate-server precheck, runtime logging, and app run.

server.app.responsibility: aiohttp application factory, route registration, background startup and cleanup.

server.handlers.responsibility: HTTP handlers, WebSocket runtime, login, auth status, uploads, incident handling, secured payload wrapping.

server.tasks.responsibility: Time broadcaster, dashboard state push, admin commands, GUI request dispatch, policy broadcasts, user actions.

server.state.responsibility: Persistent state, policy defaults, normalization, versions, settings import/export, incident persistence.

server.projector.responsibility: Read-only projector HTML, SSE endpoint, projection-safe state builder.

server.auth_validation.responsibility: Runtime-only admin validation queue for logins affected by temporarily disabled CATS or AD auth.

client.main.responsibility: Client CLI, discovery, login, exam preparation, persistent recorder and buffer ownership, reconnect loop.

client.preflight.responsibility: Auth config load, server auth status fetch, CATS and AD preflight resolution.

client.exam.responsibility: Exam config/file fetch, ZIP copy, safe desktop extraction, manifest handling.

client.ws_client.responsibility: WebSocket session attempt, server event handling, UI bridge, monitor coordination, incident/evidence send and retry.

client.incidents.responsibility: Client-side policy application and incident candidate generation.

client.incident_buffer.responsibility: Durable incident and evidence retry queue across reconnects.

client.transfers.responsibility: Submission and artifact bundle construction and multipart upload.

server.ui.row_refresh.responsibility: Stable row snapshots and refresh decisions for smooth dashboard lists.

server.ui.dashboard_tk.responsibility: Tk server dashboard, settings, incidents, process database, incident rules, command controls.

server.ui.dashboard_qt.responsibility: Qt server dashboard, settings, incidents, process database, incident rules, command controls.

launcher_ui.responsibility: Tk/Qt server and client manager launchers.
